title: 20 October dated retail audit
text:
# Dated retail audit — 20 October 2026

The frozen frame has eleven named cities and two categories, including Jaipur in the previously unspecified India city slot. All22 cells now have explicit dispositions. Only Karachi and Lahore have a freshly evidenced alternative-dairy listing in this audit; zero city-qualified Pakistan meat offers were established. This is not a claim that no other products exist.

The complete retrieved catalogue inventory contains 79 product records. Detailed observations inspect 21 purposively selected candidates, failures and comparators; these are not a weighted market sample. Catalogue availability flags do not prove city stock. Blue Tribe directs buyers to quick-commerce partners. Several products have ambiguous net weight; its party-pack title600g conflicts with a400g variant field. GoodDot's variant grams cannot be assumed to be net food weight. All such quantities remain held.

Two alternative-dairy listings are usable as dated descriptions: Naheed soy drink300ml at PKR950, Karachi; Tayyib almond milk500ml at PKR1150, Lahore, subject to a PKR3000 minimum order. Listed availability is not tested fulfilment. Nutrition-basis prices remain null.

No fresh conventional milk comparator passed inspection; no ratio was calculated.

Dr Nutrition's Nadura is out of stock. StarLife has an unauthenticated product/pack and questionable price context. Shoppingbag explicitly marks its price unconfirmed and requires stock/landed-cost confirmation. NIFDO mixes conventional and alternative products in imported catalogues. BigBasket returned403; DMart's browser remained blank. None supplies a qualified Pakistan meat observation.

Liquid prices stay per litre, not per kilogram. No density, protein content or missing price was imputed. Original2026-10-19 captures remain separate, including unavailable historical bytes. No estimator, price model input or Pakistan total changed.

The protocol's grouped city fallback was followed by one additional disclosed comparator/Pakistan query batch. No new sampling city or retailer was introduced. See observation-notes.json for the exact limitation and Rill observations, and source capture ledgers for original versus transformed representations. Further completion needs city-specific fulfilment and authenticated product-label evidence, potentially a human local-shop audit; this requires a separate collection decision.
note: Exact retained source text. Its historical date and scientific limits remain unchanged.
